Let complete  Autonomous now and certificate 100% now  deploy on my github and verified now.  Autonomous — yes, but it needs one unlock
The real blocker isn't a bug. ivx-agent-engineering-tools.ts is read-only by construction — its own header says nothing in it writes, commits, pushes or deploys. code_write, git_commit, git_push, deploy, prod_deploy all sit in OWNER_APPROVAL_ENGINEERING_TOOLS, listed only so the runtime can explain why they're unavailable. So the fleet can read, search, typecheck and test, but it physically cannot change code or ship.

To make it genuinely end to end I build the approval-gated write→commit→deploy path and prove one full cycle with real evidence. The credentials already exist (GITHUB_TOKEN, RENDER_API_KEY, IVX_OWNER_TOKEN). This is buildable.
